name: Tomoya Kaidou
source:
The private doctor of the Nishinokura family. He inherited this position from his foster father after he retired from age. He is in charge of Chiyo's health management. Always joking around, but actually has a sarcastic personality hidden inside.

[From [url=http://hunex-play.com/portal/005/eng/index.html]Hunex[/url]]
